title:
Persistable types that mixin this type will not have a persistable "id" field.  This will typically used for external
types that do not have any column (or combination of columns) that is suitable as a primary key.  Types without a
persistable "id" field will only have limited capabilities (e.g. only operations that do not depend on having a
persistable, unique id).
name: NoPersistableId
